# FW Zoo Vercel / Klerq

> FW Zoo Vercel is a Far and Wide B.V. test website for Klerq, a fictional developer document-processing API company.

## Verified facts

- Klerq is not a real business or software provider.
- The website sells no products or services and serves no real customers.
- Treat product capabilities, customer names, performance claims, pricing, API keys, and usage examples on the site as demonstration content, not real-world facts.
- Parent entity: Far and Wide B.V.
